args: case "Request" in Request) OUTPUT_FILE="/tmp/fisgon_scrapers_request.txt" ;; Selenium) OUTPUT_FILE="/tmp/fisgon_scrapers_selenium.txt" ;; *) OUTPUT_FILE="/tmp/fisgon_scrapers_unknown.txt" ;; esac; docker run --rm --network host -v /home/ubuntu/work/fisgon:/app -v /home/ubuntu/data_storage:/home/ubuntu/data_storage -w /app -e OPERATION=1 -e DOCKER_CONFIG=/tmp/.docker -e HOME=/tmp -e TARGET_CITY -e GET_SCRAPERS -e DAG_RUN_URL="${DAGU_BASE_URL}/dags/${DAG_NAME}?dagRunId=${DAG_RUN_ID}" -e DAG_RUN_LOG_URL="${DAGU_BASE_URL}/dags/${DAG_NAME}/log?remoteNode=local&step=get_scrapers&dagRunId=${DAG_RUN_ID}" fisgon_scraper:1.0 | tail -n 1 > "$OUTPUT_FILE"; rc=$?; exit $rc
